sessions.phase_label: Igbo UGC video production, review, and reshoots

requirements.title: Igbo-Language UGC Video
requirements.definition: Produce one completed UGC-style video performed in Igbo.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested artifact count and Igbo-language format; budget, delivery deadlines, exact script wording, opening performance, and game-demonstration actions are outside this Requirement.

requirements.title: Opening Phone-Message Staging
requirements.definition: Open with the actor presenting the specified message as something received and read from the phone that is subsequently used for the game demonstration.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently testable opening performance and phone interaction; the exact words spoken and the later fake-versus-real app sequence are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Exact Spoken Opening Message
requirements.definition: Speak the required opening message aloud on camera using the supplied Igbo wording with clear and correct delivery.
requirements.boundary_note: The opening sentence has its own repeated failure and correction trajectory, so it is separate from both visual phone staging and delivery of the remainder of the script.

requirements.title: Exact Delivery of Remaining Script
requirements.definition: After the opening message, deliver the remaining supplied narration exactly according to the approved script without adding or substituting content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers textual compliance for the post-opening narration; it excludes the separately testable opening sentence and the visual execution of game actions.

requirements.title: Fake-to-Official Game App Demonstration
requirements.definition: Demonstrate the scripted sequence on the phone: show a losing fake app, switch to the official app, place the specified bet, show the win and withdrawal, and show confirmation that the money reached the account.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats the fake-versus-official app walkthrough and withdrawal outcome as one tightly coupled demonstration sequence; exact narration wording is represented separately.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer states that the translated script exceeds a 90–120 second duration and cannot include all game actions within that time, but the supplied history does not show the client explicitly establishing or resolving a duration requirement.
